description: F129 (Sprint 51): Review "No Rule" Items screen -- entry point, account filter chips, and the covered-item sweep's reload path. COVERS the Sprint 50 surfaces MT-3 (entry point on the home screen) and MT-2c (sweep runs on every load). READ-ONLY: navigates and clicks filter chips only -- creates no rules, adds no safe senders, marks nothing processed -- so it is inherently net-zero on the dev DB; the final case returns to the home screen. TWO HARNESS CONSTRAINTS drove this design (Sprint 51 discovery, both re-confirmed live): (1) `ww_assert*` is NOT replayable by the script runner (README line 195) -- a case containing only asserts reports FAILED even when the UI is correct, so verification here is expressed as CLICKS: a click that resolves proves the element exists with that exact name, and a missing element errors the step. (2) The Windows UIA projection of Flutter semantics surfaces only widgets carrying a `tooltip:` plus screen titles and Text nodes; `Semantics(label:)` on a merged container does NOT project, so home-screen account ROWS are unaddressable by name and are deliberately not used. SELECTORS VERIFIED LIVE 2026-07-28 against dev build 0.5.8.

testCases.title: MT-3 + MT-2c: entry point opens the screen, filter chips render, reload re-runs the sweep, Back returns home

steps._comment: MT-3: the Review No Rule entry point exists on the home screen and opens the screen. A resolve failure here means the Sprint 50 MT-3 entry point regressed.

MT-2c evidence: with a populated pool the count chips carry the post-sweep totals. These are what change when the sweep drops covered items, so clicking them proves the sweep produced a coherent count rather than an empty screen. Counts are data-dependent -- prefix match keeps the script valid across scans.
MT-2c: Refresh re-enters _loadItems, which runs the covered-item sweep before display. The screen must survive the reload with its chips intact.
Teardown: return to the home screen. Clicking the entry point again proves we are back and the button still resolves.
